title: Is [18F]-DPA-714 PET a good marker of neuroinflammation in autoimmune encephalitis? (EAI-714)
official: Is [18F]-DPA-714 PET a good marker of neuroinflammation in autoimmune encephalitis? (EAI-714)
summary: Main objective: Whole-brain [18F]-DPA-714 binding potential (BP) in autoimmune encephalitis patients compared to healthy controls.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age 18-80 years
2. meeting clinical criteria for "possible" AE with identified antibodies; newly diagnosed with symptoms <6 months
3. no second-line immunosuppressive treatment;
4. high or mixed TSPO binding affinity phenotype.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Pregnant women
2. contraindications to MRI
3. known allergic reaction to [18F]-DPA-714
4. legal protection measure
5. paraneoplastic syndrome following immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
